summary_en: Acquisition of 100% of Muing K.K. from Ebara Corporation, JGC Holdings Co., Ltd., and Mitsubishi Corporation completed as of 1 July 2026. Muing becomes a core operating subsidiary alongside Maeda Construction, Maeda Road, Maeda Fabrication, Japan Wind Development, and Sumitomo Mitsui Construction. Combined water-engineering and project-management capabilities enable end-to-end water-infrastructure (design, construction, maintenance, operation) and expansion into infrastructure services.
title_en: Notice regarding completion of acquisition of shares of Muing K.K. (full subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
On 1 July 2026, INFRONEER Holdings completed its acquisition of 100% of the shares of Muing K.K. from three co-owners: Ebara Corporation, JGC Holdings Co., Ltd., and Mitsubishi Corporation. The transaction had been announced on 14 April 2026. Muing is now a wholly-owned subsidiary and designated as a core operating subsidiary alongside other major subsidiaries including Maeda Construction Industrial, Maeda Road, Maeda Fabrication, Japan Wind Development, and Sumitomo Mitsui Construction.

The acquisition is structured to combine Muing's water-treatment engineering capabilities and field engineers with INFRONEER's project-management optimization capabilities and civil/architectural expertise. This integration is intended to enable seamless end-to-end water-infrastructure delivery (design, construction, maintenance, and operation). Additionally, Muing's maintenance-management base will serve as a platform for expansion into broader infrastructure services (road and public-facility management), which INFRONEER identifies as part of its "comprehensive infrastructure services" strategy. The filing states this transaction carries significant strategic value for both groups and is expected to enhance overall enterprise value.
